head: Finnie sparks a Red Wings comeback
paras: Justin Faulk got the scoring started for the Red Wings on the power play midway through the first. Keegan Kolesar and Barclay Goodrow fought late in the period, and Dmitry Orlov tied it up for San Jose on the power play late in the period. Macklin Celebrini put the Sharks ahead 2-1 early in the second. Ivar Stenberg made it 3-1 on the power play early in the third, but Emmitt Finnie pulled the Wings within one a little over two minutes later. With the goalie pulled and a minute and a half left, Alex DeBrincat tied it 3-3. Lucas Raymond scored the only goal of the shootout for the Red Wings. Celebrini finished with a goal and two assists.

The Sharks had a little more of the play. The Red Wings had the finish. John Gibson, who gave up five goals against New Jersey in his last start, made 31 saves for the Red Wings, and Alex Nedeljkovic stopped 24 of 27.

The Sharks hit a post and the crossbar and still lost. The Red Wings moved to 3-3-2, climbing off the bottom of the Atlantic, now seventh. The Sharks fell to 4-3-1 but climbed to fourth in the Pacific.

items.text: Lucas Raymond’s six-game point streak against San Jose ended.
Dmitry Orlov scored his first goal of the season, his first since Mar 21 (21 games played since).
Alex DeBrincat is now one goal from 300.
Luca Cagnoni was in NHL.com’s projected lineup, but Darnell Nurse played instead.
